sub_sector.value: branded confectionery: candy, chocolate and bubble gum

product_category.detail: Candy, chocolate and bubble gum confections such as Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Pops, Dots, Junior Mints.

market_position.detail: Iconic national candy brands focused on quality at competitive, affordable prices.

distribution_model.detail: Sold through supermarkets, warehouse and membership stores, vending, dollar, drug and convenience stores.

purchase_frequency.detail: Impulse candy purchases and seasonal occasions, sold at convenience and checkout venues.

notes: Purchase frequency is judged from the nature of candy; the evidence does not state it.
